_usage: Copy this file to mcp-config.json and fill in your values. mcp-config.json is gitignored — never commit it. Run 'node scripts/github-app-token.js && source .secrets/.env' before any GitHub operations.
_architecture: All persona/agent definitions live in .claude/agents/*.md — filesystem-first, offline-capable, no remote server needed.

agency-agents._note: Local filesystem MCP server. Reads .claude/agents/*.md + library/. No network, no auth, works offline.

filesystem._note: File read/write/search across the whole project + Claude config dir.

github._note: Official GitHub MCP server. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN — run scripts/github-app-token.js first.

sequential-thinking._note: Superpowers layer — forces step-by-step thinking before implementation.

ast-grep._note: Structural code analysis via AST. Use for impact radius, symbol search, refactor preview.
